name: Spinner Jessie

intro.text: Jute's rough on the hands and loud on the ears. We used to talk in the mill by lip-reading over the racket. Can you read my lips? They're saying 'battle'.

win: Och, you've got a good loom-hand on you.
after: The jute came from Bengal, and the oil to soften it came from Dundee's whaling ships. The town was one big machine.
